hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(git|gh)[[:space:]]' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'co-authored-by:.*(claude|anthropic)|generated (with|by) \[?claude|claude\.ai/code|noreply@anthropic\.com|claude-session|🤖' && { echo 'Blocked: remove the Claude attribution from this git command' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

Take the name and email from the user'\''s earlier commits and commit with git -c user.name=<name> -c user.email=<email> commit. If there are none, ask' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
